message.content:
<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
from pathlib import Path
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
config_path = ROOT / "inputs" / "wikidata" / "city_config.json"
out_path = ROOT / "outputs" / "t07_query.sparql"

with config_path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
    cfg = json.load(f)

city_qid = str(cfg.get("city_qid", "")).strip()
country_qid = str(cfg.get("country_qid", "")).strip()
poi_types = [str(t) for t in cfg.get("poi_types", [])]


def sparql_string(value: str) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)


if city_qid:
    location_block = f"""  VALUES ?city {{ wd:{city_qid} }}
  ?item wdt:P131|wdt:P276 ?city ."""
elif country_qid:
    location_block = f"""  VALUES ?country {{ wd:{country_qid} }}
  ?item wdt:P17 ?country ."""
else:
    location_block = "  # No city or country identifier configured"

if poi_types:
    type_values = "\n".join(f"    {sparql_string(t)}" for t in poi_types)
    type_block = f"""  VALUES ?typeName {{
{type_values}
  }}
  ?item wdt:P31 ?type .
  ?type rdfs:label ?typeLabel .
  FILTER(LANG(?typeLabel) = "en")
  FILTER(STR(?typeLabel) = ?typeName)"""
else:
    type_block = "  ?item wdt:P31 ?type ."

query = f"""PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?itemLabel ?coord WHERE {{
{location_block}
{type_block}
  ?item wdt:P625 ?coord .
  SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,es". }}
}}
"""

out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path.write_text(query, encoding="utf-8")
</solution_file>
